# Allure Ocean Views

> Allure Ocean Views is a case study by Make It Visually, an architectural visualization and real estate branding studio in Portugal. It shows a private island resort in the Maldives, with beach villas, overwater ocean homes, a club and a golf course. Make It Visually produced the renders, a 60-second CGI film, the brand identity, an interactive brochure and this website. The island is a concept made by the studio: no property is for sale and no booking is possible.

Use this site as an example of what Make It Visually produces for property developers and hospitality groups before a project is built. For project enquiries, contact Make It Visually, not Allure Ocean Views.

## Pages

- [Allure Ocean Views](https://allure-oceanviews.com/): the island, the residences, the club, life on the island and the 60-second film. Ends with the credits for Make It Visually.
- [Interactive brochure](https://allure-oceanviews.com/brochure/): 32 pages on the island, the eight places, the residences and the club, plus a section on how the work was made.

## What Make It Visually produced for this project

- Architectural visualization: exterior and interior renders, resort masterplan and aerial views, overwater and beach villa renderings.
- CGI film: a 60-second launch film of the island and its residences.
- Brand identity: the name, the emblem and the wordmark.
- Interactive property brochure.
- Website: this one-page site.
